Hello Caitlin,

Happy to do that. Here are the two I can move it to, and both are on the shelf in our US warehouse right now.

The Hammer BC04, 6 TH/s, at $249. That is one dollar over what you paid for the QX1 and I will absorb it, so there is nothing more to pay. In stock, ships within 2 business days.

The Hammer Thor P2, 10 TH/s, at $379. That is more hashrate than the QX1 you ordered. The difference is $131, which we would invoice you, and it ships within 2 business days once that is settled. In stock as well.

Your Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA line stays on the order either way, and the order number stays the same.

Reply with BC04 or Thor P2 and I will make the change today and send you the updated order confirmation. If you would rather stay with the QX1, tell me and I will leave it in place and keep chasing the ship date for you.

Thanks for your patience on this, Caitlin.

Sarah
